summary: First iteration full-stack test of EvoNut MVP. Backend: 19/20 pytest tests pass. Frontend: landing/lead form/login/dashboard/patient list/patient detail tabs all work. Single backend failure is on /api/patients/{id}/meal-plan due to Emergent LLM key budget exceeded ($0.0155 used > $0.001 max) — code logic is correct, AI integration with Claude Sonnet 4.5 verified working in chat + analysis. Auth (httpOnly cookie, samesite=none, secure), JWT, bcrypt all OK. AI Anamnesis chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returns persisted reply. Public lead → anamnesis → chat → schedule full flow works. Patient detail tabs (Anamnese, IA, Antropometria, Plano, Comparativo) render. Frontend has comprehensive data-testid coverage.

minor.issue: Returns raw 500 if Emergent LLM call fails (budget/network). Should wrap ai_meal_plan call with try/except and return 503 with friendly message — like /api/public/chat does.
Same as meal-plan — no try/except around Claude call. AI failures bubble up as 500.
No brute-force lockout (per playbook recommendation: 5 fails → temporary block). Consider adding rate-limit/lockout.

issues: Date input uses native HTML5 browser date picker (`mm/dd/yyyy`) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component. For a pt-BR app this is jarring (American format and inconsistent with the dark premium theme).

action_items: Wrap AI calls in /api/patients/{id}/analysis and /api/patients/{id}/meal-plan with try/except returning HTTP 503 + friendly Portuguese message (mirror the pattern used in /api/public/chat).
Replace the native HTML5 date input on PreConsulta Step 1 with a shadcn DatePicker (Brazilian dd/mm/yyyy format).
Optional: add login brute-force lockout (5 failed attempts in 15 min).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 613 lines — borderline acceptable; consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/public.py, routers/crm.py, services/ai.py, services/calc.py.

CORS allow_origins falls back to localhost:3000 only — fine because FRONTEND_URL is set, but worth ensuring the env var is required (already done) and removing the localhost fallback if you ever deploy.
/api/leads picks the FIRST nutritionist by created_at — this is fine for single-tenant MVP but does not support multi-nutri routing. Document this limitation.
/api/public/lead/{token} returns the entire patient document including `nutricionista_id` and `created_at` — minor info leak. Consider whitelisting fields returned to the public.
Slot generation uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` and tz=UTC — Brazil is UTC-3 so 09:00 UTC = 06:00 BRT. The `label` shows `09:00` which is misleading. Switch to America/Sao_Paulo timezone.
calc_macros: `cho_g = max(round(rem / 4), 0)` — if rem < 0 (very low kcal goal), CHO becomes 0 silently. Consider validation or warning.
No rate-limiting on /api/public/chat — could be abused to drain the LLM budget.
test_credentials: admin@evonut.com / evonut123 — verified working, cookie set on login, /me returns user.

rca of the issue: test_ai_meal_plan failed → backend log shows `litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.015477, Max budget: 0.001`. This is the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap, not a code defect. The endpoint code is correct; only the AI call is rejected upstream. Mitigation: top-up the LLM key budget or, at minimum, wrap the call in try/except so the user sees 503 + clear message instead of 500.
